title: James C. Mountflorence to the Secretary of State (Marshall/Madison), Paris, 18 March 1801 (NARA RG 59, T1 roll 1)

steps.what: Founders notes, web search, Tomokiyo's American list: no decipherment of the letter.
39 code groups taken from the Founders Online transcription into ciphertext.txt (measured: 39 tokens, 25 distinct).
Groups joined by full stops spell words letter by letter; comma-separated groups are words.
9-group run ABCDBEAAD = LUNEVILLE (U=V), 5-group run ABCDB = PARMA, then TUSCANY and DUPONT from shared letters; the treaty of Luneville and the Tuscany-for-Louisiana exchange as probable words.
The 15 letter values rise with the alphabet: one-part code. Word groups bracketed between letters: Spain, France, secret, Florida, Mississippi, the, to, at, but, by.
250 read as both C (TUSCANY) and 'by' (given by France); predicted the C should be 251 and the Founders figure a slip or misprint.
NARA T1 roll 1 found digitised (NAID 211302912); letter located at frame 0097 from contact sheets of frames 82-340.
All 39 groups checked against frame 0097: TUSCANY has 251 (Founders prints 250); the other 38 agree. The prediction held.
decode.py check: all 25 values in strict alphabetical order.
Armstrong THE=972 code (targets/armstrong) compared: different code ('the' 972 there, 688 here). Humphreys's State key ruled out by his 10 Apr 1801 letter.
Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 39 tokens, 25 types, en-modern order 4: reading -2.617 per letter; Verdict: too short.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.617; polyphony 0.0; 0 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached n/a

outcome.method_basis: Key rebuilt from four pattern words (Luneville, Parma, Tuscany, Dupont) and the alphabetical order of the one-part code; no plaintext of the letter or existing key used.
outcome.fraction_read_source: validation.tsv: 39 of 39 cipher tokens given a value; 12 tokens are words inferred from the alphabetical slot, 5 of them marked [?] in reading.txt

credits.note: full transcription with the code numbers (Madison/02-91-02-0009); one figure corrected here from the frame

outcome.notes: Predicted from the decipherment that the Founders figure 250 in TUSCANY should be 251; the frame shows 251. Weaker word values: 521 Mississippi, 249 but, 228 at, 688 the.

texts.label: Decipherment of the two coded sentences
texts.summary: Mountflorence reports, on Dupont's authority, that Spain has ceded to France not Florida but the Mississippi (Louisiana) with its dependencies, by secret articles at Luneville, in compensation for Tuscany given by France to Parma.

reading_review.note: Two English sentences that build sense throughout and match the 1800-1801 treaties; four word values marked [?] rest on their alphabetical slot.

prior.where: Madison Papers SS 1 p. 27 and Founders Online: 'key not found'; Humphreys (10 Apr 1801) could not decode a Mountflorence message; web search 26 Oct 2026 found nothing
